title: EDR Advanced Module
lead: The new EDR Advanced Module works with the automated pedal depressor, 73545.
body: It has the same advanced functions and performance as the full EDR Advanced Machine in a more compact, portable package. With the MOC CAT Tool as its fluid reservoir, technicians can perform advanced EDR procedures with more flexibility in the field.
benefits: Works with the automated pedal depressor, 73545
Same advanced features as the EDR Advanced Machine
Uses the MOC CAT Tool as its fluid tank, for a smaller equipment footprint
upgrade: Customers using the 73410 Module can upgrade to the new 73510 Advanced Module with the upgrade kit, 73559.
